content.value: Planning commission has received a proposal from Khulna District Commissioner to construct an airport in Khulna. The proposal presented with three alternatives sizes of airport and evaluated with the attributes of construction and environmental cost. The evaluation results are given in the following.

content.value: The trade-off between construction and environmental cost is USD 1,300,000 forUSD 2,100,000. Find out the best airport size for Khulna from the given information by using multi-attribute utility theory.
